areas.t:
[View the ADEQ Hourly Forecast for Yuma]
Satellite this morning shows that more cloud cover is in the area, and daily ozone levels will be lower today. There will be less cloud cover over the weekend and into early next week,

areas.ag: Imperial County Air Pollution Control District
areas.t: Today, gusty westerly surface winds will disperse pollutants as a trough of low pressure aloft moves onshore over southern California. However, these winds may produce patchy blowing dust in the Imperial Valley, leading to low-Moderate AQI levels.  Tomorrow, periods of calm to light south-southeaste
